goal: Select symbols to buy based on r1 and r2, ensuring I buy symbols with positive 21-session change and sell those with negative, splitting free cash across eligible symbols.
sql:
WITH features AS (SELECT CAST('AAPL' AS STRING) AS symbol, CAST(171.48 AS DOUBLE) AS close, CAST(0.0006418895575992511 AS DOUBLE) AS ret_5, CAST(-0.05479000408846735 AS DOUBLE) AS ret_21, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS ret_63, CAST(0.015019907828472108 AS DOUBLE) AS vol_21, CAST(-0.009244302790113013 AS DOUBLE) AS ma_gap_21, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS ma_gap_63, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS dd_63, CAST(-0.08799428101007523 AS DOUBLE) AS rs_spy, CAST(33 AS INT) AS days_since_filing, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS days_until_filing, CAST('2024-02-28' AS STRING) AS last_filing, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS next_filing UNION ALL SELECT CAST('MSFT' AS STRING) AS symbol, CAST(420.72 AS DOUBLE) AS close, CAST(-0.02014578101602915 AS DOUBLE) AS ret_5, CAST(0.03188462660913949 AS DOUBLE) AS ret_21, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS ret_63, CAST(0.01316978883386374 AS DOUBLE) AS vol_21, CAST(0.00979378110508411 AS DOUBLE) AS ma_gap_21, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS ma_gap_63, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS dd_63, CAST(-0.00131965031246839 AS DOUBLE) AS rs_spy, CAST(24 AS INT) AS days_since_filing, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS days_until_filing, CAST('2024-03-08' AS STRING) AS last_filing, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS next_filing UNION ALL SELECT CAST('SPY' AS STRING) AS symbol, CAST(523.07 AS DOUBLE) AS close, CAST(0.0016660189522219593 AS DOUBLE) AS ret_5, CAST(0.03320427692160788 AS DOUBLE) AS ret_21, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS ret_63, CAST(0.006094029952942508 AS DOUBLE) AS vol_21, CAST(0.014939801605598602 AS DOUBLE) AS ma_gap_21, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS ma_gap_63, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS dd_63, CAST(0.0 AS DOUBLE) AS rs_spy, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS days_since_filing, CAST(NULL AS INT) AS days_until_filing, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS last_filing, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS next_filing), latest AS (
  SELECT symbol, close AS latest_close, ret_21
  FROM features
  WHERE symbol IN ('AAPL', 'MSFT', 'SPY')
),
prev21 AS (
  SELECT symbol, close AS close_21sessionsago
  FROM bars
  WHERE symbol IN ('AAPL', 'MSFT', 'SPY')
  ORDER BY ts DESC
  LIMIT 22
),
calc AS (
  SELECT l.symbol,
    l.latest_close,
    l.ret_21,
    (l.latest_close - p.close_21sessionsago) / NULLIF(p.close_21sessionsago, 0) AS change_21
  FROM latest l
  LEFT JOIN prev21 p ON l.symbol = p.symbol
)
SELECT symbol, latest_close, ret_21, change_21
FROM calc
ORDER BY symbol
